name: Livingtale
source:
In bark in a mysterious au that is made out of flesh and seems abandoned, but it turns out there is a giant abandoned factory that rests a worn-out king named Zane. Witness Zane's routine that he has taken for over 200 years. One day a rainbow winged  skeleton named Ink stumbles onto this place called the Livingland.

Zane is a shapeshifter who is intrigued by the look of ink and decides to shapeshift into a skeleton. Ink takes Zane into different Au's unknowingly there was a evil entity named Isaac who is a parasite like angel that is slowly affecting the Au's Zane has traveled in. From there the false angel ends up absorbing into Ink known as Isaac. Isaac goes around infecting other Au's and making a army of his own to take.

It's up to Zane and other surviving characters to save what is left of the multi-verse.

[From [url=https://zippydozane.itch.io/livingtale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一个由血肉构成、看似废弃的神秘AU。那里有一座巨大的废弃工厂，住着疲惫不堪的国王Zane。一天，一具长着彩虹色翅膀的骷髅Ink偶然来到了这个名叫Livingland的地方。

Zane是一名变形者，对Ink的外貌很感兴趣，于是变形成了骷髅。Ink带着Zane前往不同的AU，却不知道有个名为Isaac的邪恶存在正逐渐影响Zane去过的那些AU。Isaac是一个寄生型天使，最终以假天使的身份附身于Ink。随后，Isaac开始感染其他AU，建立自己的军队。

Zane和其他幸存角色必须拯救这个多元宇宙残存的一切。

[来源：[url=https://zippydozane.itch.io/livingtale]Itch.io[/url]]
